changelog: FIX (critical): Wired the previously-defined-but-never-called main-looper resilience handler that suppresses three documented Compose framework races. Crash Monitor showed 49 IllegalStateException (`FocusRequester is not initialized`) on v131 in 24 h — all of those will now be silently survived. Same defined-but-not-registered pattern as the v131 Coil mapper bug.
FIX: Lowered Coil image-cache memory percentages on Lite-mode Fire Sticks (AFTKA, AFTKM, AFTKRT) to recover ~20 MB heap headroom and reduce OOM kills.

PERF: Pre-warm the bundled-asset JSON indices off the main thread during deferred init, so first-composition image lookups are O(1) hash hits instead of blocking on a 397-entry Moshi parse. Narrows the framework-race window that triggered v131's IllegalStateException spike.
INHERITED v1.44.131: API-bake architecture (sports, themes, top-popular TMDB metadata, 397 hero/poster images).
INHERITED v1.44.127: Auto cache-clear on launch.
INHERITED v1.44.125: Fire Stick black-screen-on-play fix (SurfaceView for Lite mode).
